scope: Captured-response before/after offline comparison and one fresh seven-question evaluation; same five-paper KB and unchanged question/Gold file.
api_budget: One decomposition and one answer per question; existing maximum one citation repair if required, no automatic response retries.
runtime: CPU, OMP/BLAS/VECLIB threads=1, torch intra/interop=1, local HF offline cache
candidate_budget: Each Dense/BM25 and RRF=60; at most 300 before dedup; subquery reranker local scores not compared across queries.

p1: about 400M; appendix 406M accepted when sourced and qualified
p3: max over document tokens for each query token
p7: no local Mac measurements, no ranking or invented milliseconds
concise Chinese refusal without irrelevant hardware numbers

review_rule: Manual inspect each answer against its actual cited passages; syntactic citation checks are separate. These fixed development examples are not holdout accuracy. Rubric and Gold are not sent to generation.
